transcript.text: Good morning everyone. I'd like to get our weekly sustainment review started. We've got used oil drums, vehicle batteries, expired medical cold packs, and empty compressed-air cylinders in the holding area, and I need to get a disposition plan signed for all of them. Before I sign anything, I need confirmed updates from each of you on your respective areas. Environmental, maintenance, medical-logistics, transportation — please walk me through where we stand on documented dispositions, scheduled transfers or pickups, and any required handling controls for each material category.
